name: Transfer_Warehouse
_about: Fields added by the HomeCartel spec v1.4 (03 Fulfillment / 05 Warehouse Request and Transfer, TR-R2): 'Sent stamps when the sender confirms loading; Received stamps when the receiver confirms quantities and signs. Differences create an exception.' Sent_At / Received_At are stamped by the server (T-2), not typed in. The Item_to_transfer grid cannot be given a new per-line field through this spec-forms mechanism (it only adds top-level fields to a form; a grid's own nested fields are not touched), so the quantity confirmation is whole-transfer, not per line: Quantities_Match (checked by the receiver) and Discrepancy_Notes (required when it is not checked) -- read by app/fulfillment/transfer.py.

fields.name: Sent_At
fields.label: Sent At
fields.helpText: Stamped by the server the first time Dispatch is checked.

fields.name: Received_At
fields.label: Received At
fields.helpText: Stamped by the server the first time Received is checked.

fields.name: Quantities_Match
fields.label: Quantities Match
fields.helpText: The receiver confirms the quantities received match what was sent. Required to mark Received.

fields.name: Discrepancy_Notes
fields.label: Discrepancy Notes
fields.helpText: Required when Quantities Match is unchecked; becomes the exception's description (TR-R2: 'differences create an exception').
